fields.title: Week of November 14 Observation — The Sun's Seat Remains Firm, Yet the Order of the Universe Trembles
fields.summary: As Apple maintains the Throne of the Sun, the upheaval among semiconductor-sector planets is shaking the order of the universe.
fields.body:
The most notable aspect of this week's universe observation is the contrast between stability and volatility. Apple maintains the Sun's position with a market cap of $5.18 trillion, confirming no change in the Throne from last week. The ranking of the top 5 planets remains unchanged: Nvidia ($3.93T), Microsoft ($3.89T), Alphabet ($3.6T), and Amazon ($2.88T) in order.

The Upheaval of the Solar System — The Duality of the Semiconductor Sector

An interesting phenomenon is the extreme polarization within the semiconductor industry. AMD recorded the week's highest gain with a 9.8% rise, and Broadcom also performed well with a 6.6% increase. By contrast, Nvidia in the same semiconductor sector plummeted -18.6%, marking the week's largest decline. This signals more than simple fluctuations of individual companies—it reads as a sign of realignment within the technology sector of the universe.

Microsoft also declined slightly by -5.7%, yet maintained its top-tier position. Visa, which dominates the payment system, fell -2.6%, showing that traditional powerhouses are not exempt from this week's upheaval in the universe.

Signals of Potential — The Rise of Hidden Powerhouses

Meanwhile, there are planets not directly shown in the rankings but observed through momentum indicators. SanDisk (momentum 263), MediaTek (216), and Dell (157) show potential upward momentum, and sustained observation is needed to see how these will influence the future order of the universe. Given that this was a calm week with neither new entrant planets nor exiting planets, their movements could become key variables determining the universe's topography in the coming week.

The universe turns, and records remain. This week's observation carries the paradoxical characteristic of 'instability within firmness.' The Sun's seat has not wavered, yet the gravitational field changes of surrounding planets make prediction difficult.
